text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services staff have reviewed the need for traffic calming, specifically speed humps on Glebeholme Boulevard, between Greenwood Avenue and Coxwell Avenue, to address residents' concerns regarding vehicle speeds. Our assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the Traffic Calming Policy has not been satisfied. Therefore, traffic calming should not be installed on the subject section of Glebeholme Boulevard.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deleted the polling requirement and approve the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Glebeholme Boulevard between Greenwood Avenue and Coxwell Avenue; and 2. Directed the City Solicitor prepare a by-law to alter sections of the roadway on Glebeholme Boulevard between Greenwood and Coxwell Avenue, for traffic calming purposes, generally as shown on the copy of, Drawing No. 421G-3243, dated December 2018, Drawing No. 421G-3259, dated December 2018 and Drawing No. 421G-3260, dated December 2018, attached to the report (January 16, 2019) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management Transportation Services.
